main_body: Wooden quench barrel with a water-filled opening on top, grey metal hoops and dark side staves
top_band: Brown rim at row 3, then dark blue water rows 4-5 and mid blue water rows 6-7. A light grey front rim or hoop at row 8 closes the ellipse.
evidence: In the x=8 column the brown back rim at row 3 leads into the water surface at rows 4-7, which is a dark-to-mid blue ellipse seen from above. Row 8 is a light grey front-rim line, and a darker wood row 9 sits under it. The barrel face continues down to row 14 with hoops at rows 10 and 13, ending at the outline on row 15. This matches the green barrel with ellipse top in the guide. The opening shows its water interior, about 4 rows tall, and the front face is about 7 rows.

style.evidence: The candidate has 14 colours against 38-40 in the references, and its median of 14 per tile is below their 17 and 20. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. Wood and water each carry only about 3 tones, and the hoops are simple one-row lines. 89% of the dark edge pixels are neutral, and the black vertical bars on the sides give a sticker-like outline, whereas the references use tinted dark tones (1% and 33% neutral). The outline is not tinted to the adjacent material, so the piece falls short of the Beodeul standard.
